verdict.rationale: Serving models over a local network is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a local server bound to the LAN. The only OpenAI-compatible endpoint described (docs-4) is the hosted Wally Cloud API. The local-run evidence (docs-6, docs-7) only covers starting a model for a tool on the same machine, not exposing it to other devices.
